title: Classic Greek Tiropita
description: A traditional Greek cheese pie that is crispy on the outside and creamy on the inside, filled with a delicious blend of feta and tiropita cheese.

ingredients.name: Tiropita cheese
ingredients.notes: Crumble the cheese into small pieces

ingredients.name: Feta cheese
ingredients.notes: Crumble the cheese into small pieces

ingredients.name: Kicked phyllo dough
ingredients.notes: Thaw the dough according to package instructions

ingredients.name: Dense butter, melted
ingredients.notes: Melt the butter in the microwave or in a saucepan over low heat

ingredients.name: Greek olive oil
ingredients.notes: Brush the olive oil on the phyllo dough to prevent drying

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Sprinkle the salt over the cheese filling

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Chop the parsley and sprinkle over the cheese filling

instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the crumbled tiropita cheese and feta cheese.
Add the melted butter, salt, and chopped parsley to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Brush the olive oil on the phyllo dough to prevent drying.
Place a layer of phyllo dough in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Spread half of the cheese mixture over the phyllo dough.
Repeat the layers, starting with the phyllo dough, then the remaining cheese mixture.
Brush the top layer of phyllo dough with the remaining melted butter.
Bake the tiropita for 35-40 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tiropita from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
